project_type: Strapi 5 CMS plugin (TypeScript admin + server sides)
build_system: Strapi 5 build system with npm scripts; plugin under cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/
test_framework: vitest with nock for HTTP mocking; tests in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/ and admin smoke tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` in cms/ to verify TypeScript compiles. 2. Run `npm run test` in cms/ to run vitest suite. Both must pass.
environment_constraints: CMS runs on Node 22.x; CGO not relevant for CMS. No Strapi runtime in tests (pure unit tests with mocks).
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns in SyncPanel, AuditViewer, ValidationPanel for admin components. Use useFetchClient for API calls. Use @strapi/design-system components. Server routes go in routes/index.ts, controllers exported from server/src/index.ts.

key_patterns.admin_components: React functional components with FetchState union type for loading/error/ok states. Use useFetchClient from @strapi/admin/strapi-admin. Components in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/components/.
key_patterns.server_routes: Routes defined in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/routes/index.ts under admin.routes array. Controllers are factory functions that receive { strapi } and return method handlers.
key_patterns.admin_client: AdminClient class in admin-client.ts accepts config from resolveAdminConfig(). Config can override baseUrl/token/payloadEnv from an Environment content type.
key_patterns.page_layout: Pages use Main, HeaderLayout, ContentLayout from @strapi/design-system. See SyncPage.tsx for pattern.
key_patterns.content_types: Flow, JDM, Connection all have optional `environment` relation (manyToOne to api::environment.environment). Environment has name, adminApiBaseUrl, operatorTokenRef, payloadEnv.

directory_structure.cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/: Admin UI entry (index.tsx), customFields.ts, pages/, components/, lib/
directory_structure.cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/: Server entry (index.ts), routes/, controllers/, services/, lifecycles/
directory_structure.cms/src/api/flow/: Flow content type with environment relation
